posts.author: Mr.Hotrod
posts.title: Re: Cop car (Not what you think(I think))
posts.html:
Here is my idea of police cars for police. Let's say there is 10 police cars in the garage of the nexus. In order for a police officer to drive a police car, mayor will have a command called /givekeys or /givecarkeys -name here- This will allow the trusted officer to use a police car.

This might be a pain to code i'm not totally sure, but when you die or when "NLR" takes place, the police officer will have to get the car keys from the mayor again in order to drive the police car, basically what i'm saying is that when the police officer dies he/she loses their keys.
